## Checklist

- [ ] Targets the `dev` branch
- [ ] No emojis in code or docs, and comments only where they explain why
- [ ] Clear, readable names; files stay short and organized
- [ ] Commit messages are a single short subject line
- [ ] `bun run check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy` adds no new warnings
- [ ] Docs in `mkdocs/` updated if behaviour changed
